SELECT question_id AS questionId, exam_id AS examId, section_id AS sectionId, question_number AS questionNumber, question_type AS questionType, large_category AS largeCategory, small_category AS smallCategory, score, correct_answer AS correctAnswer, question_text AS questionText, sort_order AS sortOrder, source_question_id AS sourceQuestionId, ai_generated AS aiGenerated
FROM exam_questions
WHERE source_question_id = #{sourceQuestionId} AND ai_generated = TRUE
ORDER BY question_id DESC
LIMIT 1
